scientific_integrity: Source moment-rigidity and earlier equal-shadow examples are attributed as established; finite checks support, but do not prove, the quantified interval and asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Only complex nilpotent three-dimensional matrices and their full numerical-shadow laws are covered; singular-value fibers are not unitary-equivalence classifications. Established trace-moment equivalence is used. Broader prior literature may contain an equivalent reformulation. Independent scientific validation is not performed.
title: Exact singular-value fibers of nilpotent three-level numerical shadows
